title: Parking Violations - 2023 - Present
description: Description: Dataset of Parking Violations in the City of Syracuse since 2023. If you are interested in viewing older parking violations, those can be viewed HERE . Important note: A lot of the addresses are not mapping right now. For the most complete tallies, please refer to the table view. We will continue to work on this and try to improve the amount of entries that can be mapped successfully. Data Dictionary: Label Definition Definition Source ticket_number The number of this ticket. This is what is listed on the parking ticket that is received and is the number that tracks this ticket internally. Parking Violations Bureau issued_date The date and time that this parking ticket was issued (MM/DD/YYY, HH:MM Format). Parking Violations Bureau location The block that this parking ticket was given. This is typically rounded to the 100 block number level. Parking Violations Bureau description The parking regulation that is alleged to have been violated. Parking Violations Bureau status The status of the payment for this parking violations. Can be either Paid in Full, Collections, Adjudication Approved, Promise to Pay, Adjudication Denied, Hearing Appeal Affirmed, Adjudication Partial, Paid in Collections, In Bankruptcy, or Administrative Review PIF. Parking Violations Bureau amount The amount (in dollars) of the fine that was charged. Parking Violations Bureau LAT The approximate latitude (not actual) that this parking violation was reported. Parking Violations Bureau LONG The approximate longitude (not actual) that this parking violation was reported. Parking Violations Bureau Dataset Contact Information: Organization: City of Syracuse Position: Data Program Manager City: Syracuse, NY E-Mail Address: opendata@syr.gov
